title: TheBerk2
description: A PvP texture pack for 1.8.9 adding fully custom blocks and items in a variety of resolutions.
body: TheBerk2 is a PvP texture pack for Minecraft verion 1.8.9. This texture pack has fully custom blocks and items. It additionally retextures the GUI, armor models, particles, sky, and more. TheBerk2 contains 8x, 16x, 32x, 64x, and 256x resolution textures. The most common resolutions found in this texture pack are 16x and 64x. TheBerk2 also makes use of custom 3D models as well as animated and connected textures. This texture pack will bring a new look to any PvP gamemode including duels, bedwars, and skywars.
